header.what: What French calls each component of a character. One name per component, one component per name, and a name concrete enough to picture.
header.seeded: Where a traditional radical name exists it is taken from Kanji Alive (https://kanjialive.com/), CC BY 4.0, Harumi Hibino Lory and Arno Bosse, and written in French. Every other name is written for this corpus, no set of names for the rest existing under a licence that permits redistribution.
header.owed: Run pnpm corpus:report to see what is still unnamed.
